goal: Reduce persistent WoW 1.12 Lua memory pressure on the AH character by compacting AuxVmangos per-item MARKET history arrays after login and idle periods while preserving transparent history access for flip/MARKET logic, and by dropping redundant diagnostic history copies from SavedVariables.
notes: Observed AH account Lua working set remained ~209 MB after /reload and ~191 MB after forced Lua 5.0 GC. SavedVariables show marketPackedItems=8188 and duplicated diagnostic purchase/sale/bid histories. Core avm_market_storage_init currently expands packed MARKET history into thousands of row.history arrays at PLAYER_LOGIN. This fix adds a last-loaded Lua 5.0-compatible memory guard: after main initialization it converts each row.history array to one packed runtime string and installs a shared __index metatable that reconstructs only the accessed row history on demand. It recompacts when idle/AH closes, forces GC only after actual compaction, and scrubs redundant diagnostic history aliases before load/logout serialization. It does not delete marketPacked, top-level purchase/sale/bid history, pricing history, or change Vendor/DE/Flip thresholds. /avmmem reports current guard status; no gameplay result is claimed before runtime test.
